title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: deleted SCHC OSCORE compression test vectors without replacements
description:
The `oscore_linklocal` (rule_id 5) and `oscore_global` (rule_id 6) test vectors were removed from `test/vectors/schc_compression.json` without any replacement vectors.

These were the only canonical test vectors for OSCORE SCHC compression in the cross-implementation test vectors file. While the unit tests in `python/tests/schc/test_headers_rules.py` still test rule 5/6 round-trip internally, removing canonical vectors eliminates cross-implementation validation for OSCORE SCHC compression.

If the removed vectors were incorrectly generated (code-under-test as oracle — violating test integrity rules), they should be replaced with independently-verified test vectors (e.g., computed via OpenSSL, pyca/cryptography, or manual hex construction). Simply removing them leaves a coverage gap.
